title: Long Night for Austin's Top Manager
summary:
*   Austin's city leaders held a five-hour special meeting almost entirely behind closed doors.
*   The primary focus of the lengthy executive session was the performance evaluation of the City Manager.
*   Despite extensive discussion, no final action was taken regarding the City Manager's review.
*   Confidential discussions also covered topics related to land acquisition and ongoing litigation.
